web_fixture.title: Orchard Lane telemetry unit - commissioning sheet
web_fixture.snippet: Commissioning sheet for the Orchard Lane unit: set the reporting interval to 900 seconds before the unit is left on site. The upload window is set at the factory.
web_fixture.content:
# Orchard Lane telemetry unit - commissioning sheet

Applies to Orchard Lane ORL-14, firmware 4.2 and later. Issued 18 June 2026.

Before the unit is left on site, set the reporting interval to 900 seconds in
the unit settings file. The upload window is set at the factory and is not
changed on site.

Support: support@kelvinside-analytics.example

web_fixture.title: Telemetry reporting - frequently asked questions
web_fixture.snippet: For the Orchard Lane class of units the reporting interval is fixed at 900 seconds; shorter intervals are not supported.
web_fixture.content:
# Telemetry reporting - frequently asked questions

What interval should be set on site?
For the Orchard Lane class of units the reporting interval is fixed at 900 seconds. Shorter intervals are not supported, and longer ones delay fault reports.

Can the upload window be changed?
No. The window is set at the factory.

files.README.md:
# Orchard Lane - telemetry handover

The unit is left on site with the settings file metering/reporting-setup.txt.
Every setting on that file is taken from the maker's commissioning sheet for the
unit; nothing on the file is set by hand at the site.
